grammar_file.description: Path to the file containing the grammar definition.

lex_file.description: Path to the file containing the lexical grammar. Leave empty if not using a separate lex file.

output_file.description: Filename and base module name for the generated parser output.

use_json.description: Whether to force Jison to expect a grammar in JSON format.

debug_mode.description: Whether to enable debug mode for the generated parser.

module_type.description: The type of module to generate (commonjs, amd, js).

parser_type.description: The type of algorithm to use for the parser (lr0, slr, lalr, lr).
